about: The lock (lib/access.mjs). A pass lives at most passMaxLifetimeSeconds. The daily limit counts turns that reach a model, per family, by the family's own date; the burst limit counts per device per minute. The synthetic sample family needs no pass and shares one small daily limit. A crisis past any limit still gets the crisis reply. These are cost guards for the founding test, set by hand; a month of real use sets the real numbers (plan section 5, Phase 6).
